controls.source: GOB 352 applies six seconds of Mez and 12 seconds of Viral Resistance -48 with AddControlImmunityTimer. The shipped damage callback deactivates its parent while the separate immunity persists.
controls.runtime: TempMods and TimedEffects install the selected player's linked records and source 734 immunity. Damage clears the parent, and immunity suppresses a new state without suppressing the independent resistance modifier.
controls.test: SelectedPacifyBreaksOnDamageButItsTwelveSecondImmunitySurvives verifies the base duration, action block, -48 resistance's typed health effect, damage break and immunity preservation. ActualNpcLandingDeflectsBeforeDamageDebuffAndProcAndOnlyRoutesToVisibleSameWorld verifies the rejected contest cannot install either part.

behavior-tests.source: GOB 352 uses a loaded Hacker Style cast outside combat on a visible hostile selection within 20 m. It has a two-second cast, 34 IS cost, 15 s reuse, base six-second Mez, -48 Viral Resistance for 12 s and the independent immunity callback.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHandler checks the selection before cost and retains its spawn across the cast. AbilityTargets and PvpCombat run the normal sight and viral contest and TimedEffects resolves the control and resistance.
behavior-tests.test: SelectedPacifyRefusesBeforeCostAndRetainsTheAdmittedSpawn checks early refusals and paid invalidation during the cast. SelectedPacifyBreaksOnDamageButItsTwelveSecondImmunitySurvives and ActualNpcLandingDeflectsBeforeDamageDebuffAndProcAndOnlyRoutesToVisibleSameWorld cover the state, resistance, damage break, immunity and defender responses. The companion stock Freeze System 1.0 and Logic Blast bootstrap exercises the shared wire lifecycle.

controls.source: GOB 393 has six-second Mez and a separate twelve-second AddControlImmunityTimer. Damage breaks Mez. Healing does not.
controls.runtime: TempMods and TimedEffects apply the state, keep its source 734 immunity after damage breaks the effect, refuse another state while immune, and remove immunity at expiry.
controls.test: SelectedPacifyBreaksOnDamageButItsTwelveSecondImmunitySurvives exercises the exact base values for 393, healing, damage, immunity and restoration. The existing stock PR313 and PR321 controls run supplies 393's native family and immunity presentation. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/321#issuecomment-7001527488

stats.source: GOB 393's raw zero stat 710 component calls AddControlImmunityTimer for 12 seconds. It carries scheduling data and does not debit Inner Strength.
stats.runtime: TimedEffects.ImmunityFor sends the plain source 734 / target 681 zero-valued immunity tuple separately from the state. It never schedules a resource debit.
stats.test: SelectedPacifyBreaksOnDamageButItsTwelveSecondImmunitySurvives checks unchanged target Inner Strength, the independent 12 s record and natural expiry. The stock control bootstrap observes the matching zero-value tuple on the shared path.

behavior-tests.source: GOB 393 uses a loaded Hacker Style cast outside combat on a visible hostile selection within 14 m. It stores a two-second cast, 20 IS, 15 s reuse, base six-second Mez and twelve-second immunity.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHandler checks the selection before cost and retains its original spawn across the cast. AbilityTargets and TimedEffects own the contest, duration, break and immunity.
behavior-tests.test: SelectedPacifyRefusesBeforeCostAndRetainsTheAdmittedSpawn checks the refusal, paid invalidation, 14 m selection guard, and load-state changes. SelectedPacifyBreaksOnDamageButItsTwelveSecondImmunitySurvives checks the exact effect and cleanup and ActualNpcLandingDeflectsBeforeDamageDebuffAndProcAndOnlyRoutesToVisibleSameWorld covers the deflected result.
